events.owner: ART presentation timestamps; CODE owns simulation and audio dispatch; SOUND owns clips
events.units: milliseconds at source step42ms; no frame-count inferred gameplay

walk.stim: Exact integrated Stim overlap bounds actual distance; no second multiplier; sustained cycle357ms

attack.cancel: No new release with born>=HP0/cancel boundary; already released particles retain attackId/packet/side,captured origin/forward,born,original age and504ms lifetime. CODE simulation exact boundary authoritative.
attack.audio: At most one burst sound voice per logical attack instance; no L/R or segment retrigger. Handle Stim overlap and partial cancellation explicitly.

events.capture: same dead instance torso; optional tiny equipment layer, not extra body bounce

death.audio: SOUND may use one aligned clip or layers with offsets. Play once per death instance; Replay seek restores state silently rather than replaying past one-shots.

positionRules.worldUnits: socket worldBU must use CODE established BU-to-world projection adapter; screen coordinates top-left origin
positionRules.attackSocket: socket.weapon.flame.L / .R anatomical sides; forwardWorld captured at release
positionRules.bunker: Use actual CODE shot port position and direction; hidden unit rig and Bunker centre are not emitter positions. One audio burst per occupant attack instance.

events.pauseReplay: Pause/resume shifts logical age without duplicate starts; seek must not replay historical one-shots; finished/canceled voices disposed by owning audio adapter.
